sql: INSERT INTO NXDNP.MV_ORA_XDIFF_TGT (ID, C_NUM, C_NUM_PS, C_VARCHAR2, C_CHAR, C_NVARCHAR2, C_DATE, C_TS, C_TS3, C_TS6) WITH ranked AS (   SELECT x.ID, x.C_NUM,          CASE WHEN t.AMT IS NULL THEN x.C_NUM_PS ELSE ROUND(x.C_NUM_PS + t.AMT, 2) END AS C_NUM_PS,          x.C_VARCHAR2, x.C_CHAR, x.C_NVARCHAR2, x.C_DATE, x.C_TS, x.C_TS3, x.C_TS6,          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY x.C_CHAR ORDER BY x.ID) AS rn   FROM NXDNP.MV_ORA_XDIFF_SRC x   LEFT JOIN NXDNP.MV_ORA_TEST_SRC t ON MOD(x.ID, 300) + 1 = t.ORDER_ID ) SELECT ID, C_NUM, C_NUM_PS, C_VARCHAR2, C_CHAR, C_NVARCHAR2, C_DATE, C_TS, C_TS3, C_TS6 FROM ranked WHERE rn >= 1
